value.rationale: Optimizing translational heat throughput in a chiral active harmonic oscillator is a physically motivated parameter-design problem. The exact parameter-continuous phase diagram demonstrates a first-order loss of optimal rotational diffusion and its separate continuous reappearance at larger chirality, which an achiral resonance or a free-diffusion result cannot supply. The limitation to critical damping and the exclusion of angular-drive heat are explicit.
